function toggleBooks(set, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-book-toggle-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    var showA = (set === 'a');
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-book-set-a-head').forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = showA ? 'table-row' : 'none'; });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-book-set-b-head').forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = showA ? 'none' : 'table-row'; });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-book-set-a').forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = showA ? 'table-cell' : 'none'; });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-book-set-b').forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = showA ? 'none' : 'table-cell'; });
}

function togglePeriod(period, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-period-toggle-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelector('.sp-tbody-fg').style.display = (period === 'fg') ? 'table-row-group' : 'none';
    document.querySelector('.sp-tbody-1h').style.display = (period === '1h') ? 'table-row-group' : 'none';
}

function openGameDetail(gamecode) {
    var overlay = document.getElementById('sp-gl-modal-overlay');
    var body = document.getElementById('sp-gl-modal-body');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;text-align:center;color:#888;">Loading...</div>';
    overlay.style.display = 'flex';

    // Detect active period
    var period = 'fg';
    var activeBtn = document.querySelector('.sp-period-toggle-btn.active');
    if (activeBtn && activeBtn.textContent !== 'Full Game') period = '1h';

    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', 'game_lines_detail.php?gamecode=' + encodeURIComponent(gamecode) + '&period=' + period, true);
    xhr.onload = function() {
        if (xhr.status === 200) {
            body.innerHTML = xhr.responseText;
        } else {
            body.innerHTML = '<div class="sp-empty">Error loading game data.</div>';
        }
    };
    xhr.onerror = function() {
        body.innerHTML = '<div class="sp-empty">Error loading game data.</div>';
    };
    xhr.send();
}

function closeGameDetail() {
    document.getElementById('sp-gl-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
}
